# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_static_routes (Data Source)

Use the `cloud_router_static_routes` data source to list static routes, optionally filtered by VRF or network service config



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `network_service_config` (String) Filter by network service config ID
- `static_routes` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--static_routes))
- `vrf` (String) Filter by VRF ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--static_routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `static_routes`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the static route
- `network_service_configs` (List of String) List of network service config IDs this static route is attached to
- `next_hop` (String) Next hop IPv4 address or 'aggregate'
- `prefix` (String) IPv4 prefix in CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.0.0/24)
- `vrf` (String) VRF ID (derived from network service configs)

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
